lineage.strategy: Acquire current SEC-filed sales, margin and balance-sheet evidence for Alpha.

observations.fact: Rockwell Automation reported fiscal Q3 2026 sales of $2.313B versus $2.144B a year earlier and net income of $408M versus $293M; nine-month sales were $6.657B versus $6.026B. Cash was $479M at June 30, while short-term commercial paper was $684M.

risks.risk: Management said margin gains were partly offset by input costs exceeding price realization, while short-term commercial-paper borrowings rose from $522M at September 2025 to $684M at June 2026.

unknowns.unknown: Scout does not determine normalized margin or leverage scoring; Alpha must map the source data into the locked rubric.

recommendation: Use as current source-addressed growth, profitability and liquidity evidence for Alpha underwriting.
